Widget 3.0 released

The Widget project shipped version 3.0 on 14 October 2026 after two years of work by a volunteer team of maintainers.

Performance

Startup time dropped by 40 percent compared with version 2.4, according to the maintainers' own benchmark suite run on commodity laptops.

Licensing

The licence changed from GPL-3.0 to Apache-2.0, which the maintainers say makes it easier for companies to adopt the library in closed products.

See the full changelog.

Support

Version 2.x will receive security fixes until 30 June 2027, and no new features will be added to the 2.x line from now on.
